patch_description: Keeps the proven machinery (soft-min/soft-max annealed L-BFGS polish plus exact greedy hill-climb) but restructures the compute budget per the recommendation: Phase 1 is trimmed to a compact seed library (D6 ring grid, Tammes seed, a twisted-heptagon antiprism family, and two random seeds) instead of an expensive sweep, and the saved time is reinvested in many perturb-and-reanneal restarts around the incumbent. The anneal chain uses a scale-invariant free-space objective (soft-min of distances plus soft-max) so both the numerator and denominator of the ratio are optimized jointly, and each annealed candidate is hill-climbed on the exact ratio for fine polish. Everything is deterministic (fixed seeds) and normalized to unit diameter before return.
